newsitem.title: BRAZIL: BRAZIL SHRS EXTEND GAINS, UP 3.54 PCT, ON TELEBRAS.
newsitem.headline: BRAZIL SHRS EXTEND GAINS, UP 3.54 PCT, ON TELEBRAS.

text.p: Brazilian shares extended gains, rising 3.54 percent in late afternoon trade as benchmark Telebras continued rising on bright privatization prospects, brokers said.

The Bovespa index of the 47 most active stocks was up 421 points at 12,330 points at 1605 local/1905 GMT, less than an hour before the market's close. Total market turnover was 667.4 million reais ($617.4 million).
Telebras soared after Communications Minister Sergio Motta reiterated government plans to privatize the whole Telebras system by the middle of next year, traders said.
They said Motta's comments to reporters cheered a market, which traded down for four sessions in a row.
Telebras preferred surged 5.48 percent to 154 reais.
Stocks of Telebras' subsidiaries also traded higher. The biggest winner was Telemig preferred, which soared 6.49 percent to 197 reais.
Telesp preferred was up 2.05 percent to 349 reais. Telerj preferred rose 3.24 percent to 175 reais.
